result.verification: No true CLM-007 blocker found. Nonblocking follow-ups (do not gate this task): (a) test-coverage gap — publication-gate.test.ts and review-validation.test.ts are substantive and directly exercise the none-category/objection-routing logic, but neither has an explicit unit test for the ensemble deadlock branch (agreement=\"none\" forcing forceReview+verifySkipped in classify.ts) or an assertion that the changelog API nulls all three fields (dimension/severityTier/severityValue) together for category=\"none\" rows — behavior is implemented and independently verified by direct code reading, this is a regression-safety hardening item, not a doc/contract reconciliation gap; (b) content/methodology-pulse.md's classify-voter prose emphasizes \"three voters\"/\"all three agree\" language without foregrounding that minimumQuorum=2 lets the ensemble proceed on two successful voters — a copy-clarity nit, not a factual contradiction; (c) the wider Pulse methodology remains explicitly experimental/unvalidated (evaluation.externalValidation=\"not_completed\" in the contract itself) — this is intentional and already tracked outside CLM-007 per the master plan's gating; per review scope I am not recommending it be pulled into CLM-007. I could not execute `npm test`/`node --test` directly (command required interactive approval unavailable in this read-only worker context) — I substituted direct reading of the new test files, which are substantive, not superficial.
